stories.title: Freed Israeli Hostages Still Had Shrapnel in Their Bodies From Oct. 7 Attack
stories.summary: Some Israeli women freed from captivity still had shrapnel in their bodies from the October 7 attack, according to the Wall Street Journal. An Israeli medical official said some were held alone for extended periods and spent eight months in tunnels.
